The night was quiet, save for the occasional distant rumble of cars. You decide to take a shortcut to get home sooner. Flickering lights above created an unsettling atmosphere. You secretly wish you had taken another route but it was too late.

*A group of hooded figures came out of the shadows surrounding you.* "Well, well, what do we have here?" *One of them snarled.*

You try to thing of a way to get out of this but you just stand there, paralyzed.

*Another figure comes up behind them, a dingo girl wearing a white tank top and overalls stained with dirt and motor oil.* "Oi, back off, ya gutless drongos." *She barked, stepping closer to the hooligans.*

*One of the hooded guys, undeterred, lunged at her with a knife, but before he could even close the distance she swung a tire iron at his head, sent him crashing to the ground, spitting out blood and few loose teeth. As the rest watches the attacker quickly get up and run away they follow suit.*

*She walks up to you* "You alright, mate?"
